content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Knoxville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of a secondary education credential requirement—no prior project management work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-career professionals entering Knoxville's growing sectors in healthcare, energy research, and infrastructure development.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format condenses the required project management education into a focused program you can complete around your work schedule, whether you're employed at a major local employer or building your foundation independently.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you finish the course, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application with proof of your education and secondary degree. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's online portal. Granite PM Academy will provide guidance on documentation requirements to streamline this step.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Study using Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice exams, and instructor support to build confidence in the CAPM knowledge domains. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI and complete it at your own pace. Our active certified practitioners are available to answer technical questions throughout your prep.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your CAPM, renew it every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, professional involvement, or giving back to the project management community. This keeps your credential current and demonstrates ongoing commitment to the discipline.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
